title: Sweep Muon matrix LR (0.04 -> 0.05)
description: Increased MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 (25% higher Muon LR for transformer matrix params), all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb regressed to 1.005993 vs baseline 1.002279 - higher Muon LR hurts at this batch/time budget. The original MATRIX_LR=0.04 appears near-optimal (or the true optimum is below 0.04, not above). Next step for anyone pursuing this lever: try MATRIX_LR=0.03 (lower) instead, not higher; but given a full miss in the untested direction, I'd deprioritize further LR sweeps in favor of orthogonal mechanisms not yet touched (e.g. window pattern, weight decay schedule).
